ec562.title: Fourier Optics: Graduate Lecture Notes
ec562.summary: Lecture notes by NK Nguyen, part of Elements of Fourier Optics: A Computational Approach (submitted to Springer). Begun from Luca Dal Negro's EC 562 lectures at Boston University and expanded with derivations, figures and Python code.
sources: BU ENG EC 562, Fourier Optics in Engineering
ec562.book: Elements of Fourier Optics: A Computational Approach
ec562.about: All text and figures are my own. The draft began as my notes on Luca Dal Negro's EC 562 Fourier Optics in Engineering lectures at Boston University (Fall 2023) and has grown well beyond them, with derivations, worked examples and extensive Python code.
